package fx

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/hostisan/hostisan/internal/i18n"
	"github.com/hostisan/hostisan/internal/jobs"
)

const searchMissingMsg = "Search needs a query."

var (
	alphaMsg    = "Alpha " + "message."
	notAMessage = "Not a message."
)

const (
	groupedMsg, otherMsg = "Grouped message.", "Other message."
)

func f(w http.ResponseWriter, j *jobs.Job, s *server, lang, svc, name string) {
	WriteError(w, 400, "invalid", "Write error message.")
	httpapi.WriteError(w, 400, "invalid", "Qualified write error.")
	WriteError(w, 400, "invalid", "")
	_ = jobs.Failure{Code: "x", Message: "Failure message %s."}
	_ = &jobs.Failure{Message: "Pointer failure message."}
	j.Step("Step message")
	s.acctTranslate(lang, "Account message")
	_ = i18n.N("Marked message")
	_ = fmt.Sprintf(i18n.N("Check %s"), svc)
	j.Step("Check " + svc)
	_ = i18n.N(name)
	fmt.Println("Not extracted")
	_ = ErrorBody{Code: "x", Message: "Error body message."}
	_ = APIError{Error: ErrorBody{Message: "Nested error body."}}
	_ = BulkFailure{Name: name, Message: "Bulk failure message."}
	WriteError(w, 400, "invalid", "Error: invalid domain format :: "+name)
}

const (
	coreMsg     = "Error: core output is shown as sent."
	pkgUsedMsgid = "Msgid-named message."
)
